ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 80% high-intensity (white) pixels to 20% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity region. Continuous low-intensity perimeter on all edges. Central vertical low-intensity band at notch. Left lobe displays multiple horizontal low-intensity finger-like extensions from the leading edge toward the center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the fluke horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography. Right lobe exhibits a deep, wide semi-circular indentation. Remaining edge shows frequent low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a concave sweep from the notch to the distal tips, which terminate in upward-pointing angles.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized clusters of high-intensity pixels (white) observed at the far distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks). Right lobe shows three distinct vertical lines and multiple diagonal scratches. Left lobe shows several shorter, horizontal/diagonal disruptions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large traumatic notch/indentation is present on the trailing edge of the right lobe. Extensive linear scarring is visible across the ventral surface of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent dark pigment column bisects the lower-central region of the fluke, extending downwards from the notch.
